title: Recessed Toilet Paper Holder 6.125-Inch Square | Sea Foam Green | Carolina | Allied Brass
short_title: Recessed Toilet Paper Holder 6.125-Inch Square, Sea Foam Green
description:
Free up elbow room around the toilet with a built-in look that keeps the paper right where you need it in Sea Foam Green, which captures the tranquil essence of ocean-inspired design, bringing soft, natural color to coastal and contemporary spaces. This recessed toilet paper holder from the Carolina collection brings traditional bathroom hardware styling to a clean, in-wall installation for a finished, coordinated bath.

Highlights:
- Sea Foam Green transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Coordinate a cohesive bath with the Carolina collection, designed for classic bath accessories and heritage bathroom fixtures
- Install with confidence: coordinating mounting hardware is included for easier setup

Specs & Installation:
- Product dimensions (L x H x W): 6.125 x 6.125 x 4 in.
- Box dimensions (L x H x W): 10 x 6 x 4 in.
- Shipping weight: 2.4 lbs
- Mounting: recessed/in-wall with concealed screw mounting; all mounting hardware included
- Warranty: limited lifetime warranty
multiple designer finish options available
